text.title: 躯干模型旁的卡片
text.situation:
同一张桌的远端放着躯干模型。一张卡介绍内分泌系统，另一张展示激素作为化学信使随血液传递。萨姆在讲身体化学过程的说明中读到“新陈代谢”。讲解员没有试图一次解释所有过程；她先指出卡片对应的部分，再把模型转向访客。

萨姆：肺属于消化系统吗？
讲解员：不属于。这些标签介绍呼吸系统，它参与呼吸和气体交换。消化系统有自己的图，就在旁边。
萨姆：那张有“摄入量”的表格呢？
讲解员：它用intake表示进入身体的食物或饮料的量。访客可以在样表上看到怎样记录这个数量。

独立的卡片，相互关联的过程
内分泌：化学信息传递。
呼吸：呼吸与气体交换。
消化：分解食物并吸收营养。

paragraphs.en: A torso model stood at the far end of the same table. One card introduced the endocrine system and another showed a hormone travelling through the blood as a chemical messenger. Sam read the word metabolism in a caption about the body’s chemical processes. The guide did not try to explain every process at once. She showed where the card belonged, then turned the model towards the visitors.

paragraphs.en:
Sam: Are the lungs part of the digestive system?
Guide: No. These labels belong to the respiratory system, which is involved in breathing and gas exchange. The digestive system has its own diagram beside it.
Sam: And this form with the word intake?
Guide: It uses intake for the amount of food or drink taken into the body. Visitors can see how the amount is recorded on the sample form.

paragraphs.en:
Separate cards, connected processes
Endocrine: chemical messages.
Respiratory: breathing and gas exchange.
Digestive: breaking down food and absorbing nutrients.
